# Copilot instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — it is the single source of truth for agent rules in this repository:
the SHA-pinning policy for third-party actions, lint requirements, tag-handling rules, and the conventional-commit
expectations, each linked to its ADR in [docs/adrs/](../docs/adrs/). Do not duplicate rules into this file; add them
to AGENTS.md so every tool sees the same guidance. See ADR 0007.
